techniques.evidence: pipeline/jobfit/registry.py:330 Signals are a weighted table and all that fire accumulate, but confidence is the winner's share of mass with no mass scaling and no cap under the 0.9 declaration tier, so unanimous signals read 1.0.

pairs.registryProposal: Say whether a parallel contradiction_fired review flag satisfies the cap-below-threshold rule. These ceilings are 0.65 and 0.7 against lowConfidenceThreshold 0.55, and pipeline._archetype_needs_review still returns contradiction.
